id: \rMy Chatot says strange things.
en: \rMy Chatot says strange things.
it: \rIl mio Chatot dice cose strane.

id: \rI think I'll go to Johto.
en: \rI think I'll go to Johto.
it: \rPenso che andrò a Johto.

id: \bBrock: Hey there \PN. It's been a long time.
en: \bBrock: Hey there \PN. It's been a long time.
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN. È passato tanto tempo.

id: \bI remember this is where we first met, back when I was still a Gym Leader. Brings back a lot of memories.
en: \bI remember this is where we first met, back when I was still a Gym Leader. Brings back a lot of memories.
it: \bMi ricordo che è qui che ci siamo conosciuti, quando ero ancora un Capopalestra. Mi riporta alla mente tanti ricordi.

id: \bWhy don't we have a battle? I'm sure that will get you ready for your next challenge.
en: \bWhy don't we have a battle? I'm sure that will get you ready for your next challenge.
it: \bPerché non facciamo una lotta? Sono sicuro che ti preparerà per la tua prossima sfida.

id: \bBrock: Good luck with your final challenge. I'm rooting for you.
en: \bBrock: Good luck with your final challenge. I'm rooting for you.
it: \bBrock: Buona fortuna per la tua ultima sfida. Faccio il tifo per te.

id: \bI'm training hard so I can get my last Symbol.
en: \bI'm training hard so I can get my last Symbol.
it: \bMi sto allenando duramente per ottenere il mio ultimo Simbolo.

id: \bAn Aipom? I think I saw it running towards the Indigo Plateau.
en: \bAn Aipom? I think I saw it running towards the Indigo Plateau.
it: \bUn Aipom? Mi sembra di averlo visto correre verso l'Altopiano Blu.

id: \bBrandon: So you beat all the other Frontier Brains? You wouldn't be here if you didn't.
en: \bBrandon: So you beat all the other Frontier Brains?  You wouldn't be here if you didn't.
it: \bBrandon: Quindi hai battuto tutti gli altri Assi del Parco? Altrimenti non saresti qui.

id: \bI suppose I can give you a taste of what's to come. Just don't get upset when you see how tough it is.
en: \bI suppose I can give you a taste of what's to come.  Just don't get upset when you see how tough it is.
it: \bSuppongo di poterti dare un assaggio di ciò che ti aspetta. Basta che non ti abbatti quando vedrai quanto è dura.

id: \bBrandon: You have some skill. I look forward to your official challenge inside the Battle Pyramid.
en: \bBrandon: You have some skill. I look forward to your official challenge inside the Battle Pyramid.
it: \bBrandon: Hai talento. Attendo con ansia la tua sfida ufficiale dentro la Piramide Lotta.

id: \rMay: So you finished the Frontier? I just got my last ribbon too!
en: \rMay: So you finished the Frontier? I just got my last ribbon too!
it: \rVera: Quindi hai completato il Parco Lotta? Anch'io ho appena ottenuto il mio ultimo Fiocco!

id: \rI plan on going to Johto now to compete there. You already went there so I guess this is kind of goodbye for now.
en: \rI plan on going to Johto now to compete there. You already went there so I guess this is kind of goodbye for now.
it: \rHo intenzione di andare a Johto a gareggiare. Tu ci sei già stato, quindi immagino che per ora sia una specie di addio.

id: \rLet's put everything into this battle.
en: \rLet's put everything into this battle.
it: \rMettiamocela tutta in questa lotta.

id: \rMay: Have fun with your next journey \PN. Hopefully we will see each other soon.
en: \rMay: Have fun with your next journey \PN.  Hopefully we will see each other soon.
it: \rVera: Divertiti nel tuo prossimo viaggio, \PN. Spero che ci rivedremo presto.

id: \rI've discovered the fastest move.
en: \rI've discovered the fastest move.
it: \rHo scoperto la mossa più veloce.

id: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \rA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \rCome back anytime!
en: \rCome back anytime!
it: \rTorna quando vuoi!

id: Battle Pyramid \nLeader:\nPyramid King Brandon
en: Battle Pyramid \nLeader:\nPyramid King Brandon
it: Piramide Lotta \nAsso:\nRe Piramide Brandon

id: \bScott: You did it. \PN, it's not easy to beat my Battle Frontier. If you ever want to take the position of Frontier Brain come find me.
en: \bScott: You did it. \PN, it's not easy to beat my Battle Frontier. If you ever want to take the position of Frontier Brain come find me.
it: \bScott: Ce l'hai fatta. \PN, non è facile battere il mio Parco Lotta. Se mai vorrai diventare un Asso del Parco, vieni a cercarmi.

id: \bI want to be king.
en: \bI want to be king.
it: \bVoglio essere re.

id: \bI am king.
en: \bI am king.
it: \bIo sono re.

id: \rAipom
en: \rAipom
it: \rAipom

id: The Aipom stole your Frontier Pass!
en: The Aipom stole your Frontier Pass!
it: L'Aipom ti ha rubato il Pass Lotta!
